businessRules.statement: port.unLocode MUST match ^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{3}$ (UN/LOCODE) and be unique.
vessel.imoNumber MUST match ^IMO\d{7}$. mmsi MUST match ^\d{9}$. flag is ISO-3166 alpha-2.
Call event order: scheduled → arrived → berthed → unberthed → departed → completed. cancelled allowed before berthed; out-of-order returns Conflict 409.
container.containerId MUST match ^[A-Z]{4}\d{7}$ (ISO 6346 BIC + serial + check). dangerousGoods.unNumber MUST match ^UN\d{4}$ when present.
pollution ≥ 100t → critical; injuries ≥ 1 OR DG involved OR collision → major; pollution ≥ 1t → moderate; else minor. severity ≥ major → coast-guard report.
Incident records are append-only. Updates create a new incident with supersedes pointing at the original.
businessRules.enforcedBy: no UPDATE on incidents core fields
